agentGuide: Base path /v1; bodies are form-encoded (Allkin converts your JSON object, nested keys as metadata[order]=42). Amounts are integers in the smallest unit (1250 = 12.50 EUR). Read: GET /balance; GET /customers?email=<email>&limit=5; GET /customers/<id>; GET /payment_intents?limit=10 (status, amount, customer); GET /charges?customer=<id>; GET /invoices?customer=<id>&status=open; GET /subscriptions?customer=<id>; GET /products?active=true, GET /prices?product=<id>; search: GET /customers/search?query=email:'x@y.z', GET /charges/search?query=amount>1000 AND status:'succeeded'. Money moves ask for confirmation: POST /refunds {"payment_intent": "pi_...", "amount": 500}; POST /payment_intents; POST /payouts; POST /invoices/<id>/pay. Create a customer: POST /customers {"email": "...", "name": "..."}. Payment links: POST /payment_links {"line_items": [{"price": "price_...", "quantity": 1}]}. A test key (sk_test_) touches test data only; a live key (sk_live_) moves real money. The key is set by Allkin.
